content.title: Chapter 102 - UTILITIES — Sec. 102-42. - Billing sequence.
content.summary:
Charges shall accrue for water use and sewer service as either or both are utilized,
               and billings therefor will be prepared, issued, and become delinquent in accordance
               with schedules established by council resolution.
(Code 1981, § 33-11; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988…
